turns.text: *waves a sleeve* Hi! I’m all settled in~
*waves my open right hand in front of my face, then lowers it* Done, nya~
*tilts my head, flashes a peace sign in front of my face, then lowers it* Peace~
*peeks from my hood and waves* Hii again~

result.title: Face wave test
result.description: A four-second smooth raise, open right-hand wave directly in front of the face, and lower.

result.title: Face peace test
result.description: Raise a real two-finger peace sign directly in front of the face while tilting the head, hold briefly, then lower.
